Iranian-backed Iraqi militias Kataib Sayyid al Shuhada and Harakat Ansar Allah al Awfiya announced their commitment to an unspecified Shia Coordination Framework disarmament agreement on October 1. The agreement will likely enable the militias to retain access to their weapons,

Saudi and Yemeni government-aligned forces are attempting to disrupt Houthi advances in southwestern Yemen by conducting airstrikes targeting Houthi front-line positions, reinforcements, supply centers, and C2. (3/5) https://t.co/3iAcLrN3bD
